limits: warm exact cohorts do not prove all-scenario/all-metric superiority
runtime binding borrow cannot outlive runtime; owned builder overrides copy on write; authority/session/durability/watchdog checks remain shared
source health and reader capacity errors retain original behavior
optional view unavailable/poisoned/contended falls back to original FIFO capture
query pin registration precedes preceding-root replacement under matching view read/write guards; no permanent pin
default-off timings serialized after owned builds/tests; diagnostic profiling measured separately
profile collector intentionally discards contended samples; raw dropped/selected counts retained; averages describe retained requests
concurrent publication stress is correctness evidence, not throughput evidence
broader doc/architecture failures compared against pre-existing shared baseline
